buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Documents Required for Technical Evaluation 1 EMD Payment Receipt: Scanned copy of the online EMD payment transaction receipt in favour of MSTC LIM ITED.MSE/STARTUP's are exempted from providing EMD ,subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions stipula ted in the STC. 2 MSE Registration Certificate (if claiming EMD exemption): Certified copy of valid Udyog Aadhaar Memoran dum (UAM) / Udyam Registration Certificate (URC), clearly indicating the applicable NIC code for manpowe r supply and related services (excluding Security Services) subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions stip ulated in the STC. 3 Shop and Commercial Establishment / Trade Licence: Scanned copy of the licence issued by the appropriat e authority. 4 Contract Labour Registration Certificate: Scanned copy of registration with the appropriate authority under the Contract Labour Act. 5 PF Registration Certificate: Scanned copy of the Provident Fund (PF) registration certificate. 6 ESIC Registration Certificate: Scanned copy of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) registrati on certificate. 7 GST Registration Certificate: Scanned copy of the GST registration certificate. 8 PAN Card: Scanned copy of the Permanent Account Number (PAN) card. 9

Average Annual Financial Turnover Certificate: Certificate issued by a practising Chartered Accountant (CA ), showing average financial turnover in manpower services for the last three financial years (2025–26, 202 4–25 and 2023–24), amounting to not less than ₹25,00,000 (30% of the estimated cost) subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions stipulated in the STC.. Start-ups are exempted from this criterion, subject to submi ssion of a valid DPIIT Start-up certificate mentioning the relevant category. 10 Income Tax Return (ITR) Acknowledgements: Scanned copies of ITR acknowledgements for FY 2025–26, FY 2024–25 and FY 2023–24. 11 Work Experience / Work Completion Certificates: Scanned copies of work completion certificates demonstr ating experience in manpower supply (Highly Skilled, Skilled, Semi-Skilled and Unskilled) to Central Govern ment / State Government / PSUs / Public Listed Companies during the last three years (as on 31.03.2026), under a single contract involving 5–15 manpower personnel. Details of the concerned contact person must also be furnished. The bidder should also have a presently running contract of at least one year involving 5 –15 manpower personnel. MSE/Start-ups are exempted from these past performance and experience criter ia, subject to submission of a valid DPIIT Start-up certificate mentioning the relevant category. 12 Annexures A to E: Scanned copies of duly filled-in, signed and stamped Annexures A, B, C, D and E. - As pr ovided in the Buyer add bid specific scope of work 13 Bank Solvency Certificate: Solvency certificate issued by a bank for at least 10% of the total bid value. The certificate should not have been issued earlier than one year before the last date of submission of the tend er. 14. The Manpower Agency shall have an established office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. To substantiate the office address, the agency shall submit either (i) a latest electricity bill dated between 01.08.2026 and 31.10.202 6, or (ii) a valid GST Registration Certificate showing the office address in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 9. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 10.
